entries.title: Psalms 3:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.>> Jehovah, how many are they that trouble me, many they that rise up against me!

entries.title: Psalms 3:2
segments: Many say of my soul, There is no salvation for him in God. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 3:3
segments: But thou, Jehovah, art a shield about me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

entries.title: Psalms 3:4
segments: ¶With my voice will I call to Jehovah, and he will answer me from the hill of his holiness. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 3:5
segments: I laid me down and slept; I awaked, for Jehovah sustaineth me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:6
segments: I will not fear for myriads of the people that have set themselves against me round about.

entries.title: Psalms 3:7
segments: Arise, Jehovah; save me, my God! For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheekbone, thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 3:8
segments: Salvation is of Jehovah; thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
